BillTakeThisEeveeText:
BILL: Hi, {PLAYER}!
Do us a favor and take this EEVEE.

It came over when
I was adjusting the TIME CAPSULE.

Someone has to
take care of it,

but I don't like
being outside.

Can I count on you
to play with it, {PLAYER}?
BillImCountingOnYouText:
BILL: I knew you'd
come through!

Way to go! You're
the real deal!

OK, I'm counting
on you.

Take good care of
it!
BillEeveeMayEvolveText:
BILL: PROF.ELM
claims EEVEE may

evolve in new and
unknown ways.
BillPartyFullText:
Whoa, wait. You
can't carry any more #MON.
BillPopWontWorkText:
BILL: My pop, he
won't work. All he

does is goof off
all day long.

He's getting to be
a real headache…
BillsMomText_BeforeEcruteak:
Oh, you collect
#MON? My son BILL is an expert.

He just got called
to the #MON

CENTER in ECRUTEAK
CITY.

My husband went
off to the GAME

CORNER without
being called…
BillsMomText_AfterEcruteak:
My husband was
once known as a

#MANIAC.
BILL must have

taken after his
father.
BillsYoungerSisterUsefulNumberText:
Are you a trainer?

I've got a useful
phone number for you.
BillsYoungerSisterRefusedNumberText:
My brother made
the PC #MON storage system.

I was going to
give you BILL's number…
BillsYoungerSisterPhoneFullText:
You can't record
any more numbers.
BillsYoungerSisterStorageSystemText:
My big brother
BILL made the PC

#MON storage
system.
